VAL-TIME-007.title: Edit time entry loads pre-populated form

steps.action: POST /time-entries to create entry (scName=EditTestUser, date=2024-06-15, hours=4, accountName=TestCorpGroupB, activityType=WORKSHOP, description=EditTestGroupB)
steps.observed: 302 redirect to /time-entries, entry visible in list with id=1
Form loaded with scName='EditTestUser', date='2024-06-15', hours='4', accountName='TestCorpGroupB', activityType WORKSHOP selected, description='EditTestGroupB'

evidence.description: GET /time-entries?action=edit&id=1 returned 200. HTML form contains: input scName value='EditTestUser', input date value='2024-06-15', input hours value='4', input accountName value='TestCorpGroupB', select activityType with WORKSHOP option marked 'selected', textarea description containing 'EditTestGroupB'.

VAL-TIME-007.details: All form fields pre-populated correctly including the Activity Type dropdown with WORKSHOP selected.

VAL-TIME-008.title: Edit time entry updates and redirects

evidence.description: POST edit returned 302 with Location header pointing to /time-entries. Follow-up GET showed hours changed from 4.00 to 6.00 and description changed from 'EditTestGroupB' to 'EditedByGroupB'. Row count unchanged at 2 (1 header + 1 data row).

VAL-TIME-008.details: Edit successfully updated entry fields. PRG pattern followed (302 redirect). No duplicate entry created.

VAL-TIME-009.title: Delete time entry with confirmation

steps.action: Inspect delete button HTML in list page
steps.observed: Form has onsubmit="return confirm('Are you sure you want to delete this time entry?');"
Empty state shown: 'No time entries yet.' Row count: 0

evidence.description: Delete form in list HTML has onsubmit='return confirm(...)' for browser-side confirmation. POST delete returned 302. Subsequent GET showed empty state 'No time entries yet.' with 0 data rows. Note: curl cannot test cancel behavior of JS confirm() since that is browser-only; verified the confirm() JS is present in the HTML.

VAL-TIME-009.details: Delete form includes JavaScript confirm() dialog. POST delete removes entry and redirects. Cancel behavior verified by presence of 'return confirm(...)' which prevents form submission when user clicks Cancel in browser.

VAL-TIME-011.title: Non-existent time entry returns friendly error

steps.observed: HTTP 404 with message 'Time entry not found.'

steps.action: Check response body for java.lang. or NullPointerException
steps.observed: 0 matches - no Java stack traces in response

evidence.description: GET /time-entries?action=edit&id=99999 returned HTTP 404 with body containing 'Time entry not found.' message. Grep for 'java.lang.' and 'NullPointerException' returned 0 matches. No stack traces exposed to user.

VAL-TIME-011.details: Returns proper 404 with 'Time entry not found.' message via Jetty error page. No Java stack traces or exception details exposed.

summary: Tested 4 assertions: all 4 passed. VAL-TIME-007 (edit form pre-populated), VAL-TIME-008 (edit updates and redirects), VAL-TIME-009 (delete with JS confirm), VAL-TIME-011 (non-existent entry returns 404).
